text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp. Kitasan Black felt a 
sense of inadequacy compared to Tokai Teio 
and the others blessed with an innate, 
dazzling flair.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for some reason, she seemed 
completely at ease around Gold Ship and 
Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume inherently carry an aura of 
either the "Mainstream" or the "Outlaw."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black might just have a bit of a 
rebellious streak. Talking with the two of 
them led her to search for a way to 
overcome her inferiority complex.
